description: This file defines a REST API resource class for managing funds within the Apache Fineract platform. It provides endpoints to retrieve all funds, create a new fund, retrieve a specific fund by ID, and update an existing fund. The class leverages JAX-RS annotations for RESTful behavior, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and interacts with various service layers for security, data access, and command execution.

classes.name: FundsApiResource
classes.description: A RESTful API resource class that handles HTTP requests related to Funds such as creating, retrieving, and updating funds within the platform.

methods.name: retrieveFunds
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all funds available.

methods.name: createFund
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new fund based on provided data.

methods.name: retrieveFund
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch details of a specific fund by its ID.

methods.name: updateFund
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update the details of an existing fund identified by its ID.
